purpose: POSE DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. Not activation, frame-pacing, GPU, physical-device or production-tier evidence.

overrides.rendererDetection: UNMASKED_RENDERER_WEBGL overridden in this browser only; actual value retained below.
overrides.clock: Playwright Clock.install/pauseAt/runFor: virtual performance, timers and nominal 16ms RAF. No fastForward.
overrides.betweenCaptures: Native GL draws suppressed after the fully rendered initial scene, while application simulation and bone transforms run normally. Draws restored and RAF stepped before every screenshot.
overrides.visitorInput: Synthetic pointer activity keeps ambient simulation awake. Input behavior is covered by the separate functional suite.
overrides.camera: Normal overview/services presets, diagnostic walker/reception close-ups, and street-wide [-14,3,23] looking at [0,1.7,11] with FOV50. Reception close-up temporarily permits a camera distance below the normal orbit minimum. Local browser state only.
overrides.introspection: Read the installed R3F Canvas rootState ref through React's private fiber hooks. Fail explicitly if unavailable.
